sections.brief: Iran's programme from Atoms for Peace and the US-supplied Tehran reactor (1967), the NPT (1968/1970), the Shah's plans and NSDM 292, the 1979 halt and revival, the Khan network, the 2002 NCRI disclosures, IAEA findings (2003, 2005, the 2011 annex, the 2015 final assessment), the 2007 NIE, enrichment from 3.67% to 60%, the May 2025 stockpile, the 12 June 2025 non-compliance finding, the contested fatwa and NPT status as of 2026. Figures: time; stats

Israel's own programme: Dimona with French help (1957), the limited 1960s US visits, the 1969 Nixon–Meir understanding and amimut, Vanunu (1986) and his imprisonment, SIPRI/FAS estimates (~90), Israel outside the NPT, UNGA and IAEA resolutions and Israel's stated rationale; the asymmetry stated plainly. Figure: compare (Iran vs Israel)
